subject: depth
text: - A node is a stacking-context root for opacity not equal to 1, fixed or sticky position, z-index on relative or absolute (or static flex/grid items), any transform/rotate/scale/translate, atomic paint effects, or `isolation: isolate` (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1332-1375); atomic paint effects are opacity, filter, clip-path and mask-image (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1377-1406)

subject: depth
text: - Children paint in stacking order: negative z-index hoisted children, regular paint children, then positive z-index hoisted children (packages/blitz-paint/src/render.rs:1106-1169); hit-testing walks positive-z hoisted children, then paint children in reverse, then negative-z hoisted children (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1574-1638), skipping a node dropped since the last resolve as the paint tree's walk does (architecture §Standard Contracts → Scrolling, selection, tree), and since 2026-10-10-scrolling-box-bounds-and-hit it stops at the padding box of a node paint clips — by `overflow`, or by a computed `contain` that includes `paint` on a box paint applies it to (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18) — the root element excepted: a point outside that box reaches none of the node's hoisted children, paint children or inline content, as paint clips them, and the node itself is still answered inside its border box (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1540-1573; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-scrolling-box-bounds-and-hit/report.md); since 2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep its answer at an element's own box is measured, in both layout modes and both builds — an `img` holding raster data answers the `img`, a block inside an `iframe`'s `srcdoc` sub-document answers the `iframe` (the parent's walk does not enter the sub-document, pinned as it reads) and a filled text `input` answers the `input` — and a box both transformed and scrolled is hit where its rows show, not through its scrolled-out content (tests/blitz-tests/tests/hit_clipped_at_scrolling_box.rs:431-584; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep/report.md)

subject: expression-motion
text: - Smooth scrolls run 300 ms on a cubic ease-in-out curve (packages/blitz-dom/src/scrolling.rs:112-122; packages/blitz-dom/src/scrolling.rs:432-433); `scroll-behavior: smooth` makes `Auto` scrolls animate and `auto` behavior jumps (packages/blitz-dom/src/scrolling.rs:528-545; tests/blitz-tests/tests/fragment_navigation.rs:264-293; tests/blitz-tests/tests/fragment_navigation.rs:374-383); a wheel event over a scroller cancels an in-progress smooth scroll (tests/blitz-tests/tests/fragment_navigation.rs:356-372)

subject: expression-motion
text: - Scroll behaviour values `auto`, `instant`, `smooth` are parsed by the script runtime and passed to blitz-dom (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/element/scrolling.rs:37-52); programmatic scrolling in dioxus-native-dom supports `Smooth` and `Instant` (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/events.rs:246-249; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/events.rs:285-288)

subject: expression-motion
text: - A programmatic into-view scroll never animates a nested scrolling box: `BaseDocument::scroll_into_view` writes every scrolling box that holds its target at once, innermost first, whatever behaviour was asked — the document holds one scroll animation at a time — and the requested behaviour, `Smooth` included, applies to the viewport alone; the driver's `scroll` is instant in every box and in the viewport, made inside one settled step (packages/blitz-dom/src/scrolling.rs:655-734; packages/blitz-test-harness/src/input.rs:235-245; tests/blitz-tests/tests/scroll_into_view_nested.rs:1-10; ratified by the founder, 2026-10-07 — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-refusal-detection/report.md)

subject: expression-motion
text: - Right after a scroll the shown overlay scrollbar takes a main-button pointerdown in its band as a thumb drag (`hit_with_scrollbar` while `scrollbar_opacity > 0`) and dispatches nothing; on the virtual clock it stays shown until an `advance` passes its fade, and a pointer left on the thumb keeps it shown — so a driver `click` on a Cells cell in that band right after a `scroll` lands on the scrollbar, and an `advance` past the fade comes first (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_cells_served.rs:216-232; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_cells_served.rs:94-136; as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-25-cold-agent-bar/report.md)

text: - Active CSS animations/transitions, canvases, animating sub-documents, custom widgets, scroll animations and scrollbar fades keep the document animating (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:2292-2309); a custom widget returning `true` from `requires_redraw` causes continuous redraw scheduling (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/custom_widget.rs:100-106); a harness settle answers for every member of that set the same way — none holds it open and none is waited on or advanced: it returns `Settled` with `animating` reading the document's animating flag, the scrollbar fade's membership read off the document's clock — after a driver `scroll` it reads true until 700 ms of that clock pass (packages/blitz-test-harness/src/settle.rs:151-186; one member, a CSS animation, exercised at tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_settle.rs:247-275 — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-settle-detection/report.md)
